description.value: Kobo Ice Cream is a small-batch artisan scoop shop on Vancouver's Main Street, crafting flavours from locally sourced natural ingredients with roots in family tradition. The rotating menu spans creative offerings like London Fog, Tahini & Roasted Walnut, and Caramelized Banana, alongside dairy-free and vegan choices. The shop is sustainability-focused, using compostable or recyclable packaging wherever possible.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at koboicecream.com confirms the OSM address (2541 Main St, Vancouver, BC V5T 3E5) and corroborates the business as an artisan ice cream scoop shop. The FAQs explicitly confirm vegan and dairy-free options ('Yes! We offer rotating dairy-free and vegan flavours made with high-quality plant-based ingredients'), and the flavours page marks vegan items with '(V)'. No cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the /find-us/ subpage contains apparent leftover template content (a second address '1234 Main Street' with phone '604-555-1234' and email 'info@koboicecream.ca') that was never removed, flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM name contains a double space: 'Kobo  Ice Cream' — likely a data entry typo.

The /find-us/ subpage contains apparent website-template placeholder content that was never removed: a second location block showing '1234 Main Street, Vancouver, BC', phone '(604) 555-1234', and email 'info@koboicecream.ca'. These are not the real business details and should not be used.
Several blog posts on /news/ are miscategorized as 'Face care' rather than food/ice cream — suggests the website CMS was not fully configured after setup.

Hours inconsistency: the FAQs page states 'open daily from 12 PM – 10 PM' with no seasonal qualifier, while the home page and find-us page both show distinct seasonal winter hours. The FAQs entry may be stale or incorrect.
No phone number is present in OSM or reliably on the website (only a placeholder number appears in the template content).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A confirmed, operating artisan ice cream shop on a Vancouver street with vegan options and sustainability values — a worthwhile sweet stop for touring cyclists passing through the Main Street corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email confirmed as info@koboicecream.com across multiple pages. Postal code V5T 3E5 found on website /find-us/ page but not in OSM tags.

Takeout.detail: Scoop shop format — ice cream is served to-go as the primary service mode; website presents the product as individual scoops with no mention of dine-in seating

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQs state 'Yes! We offer rotating dairy-free and vegan flavours made with high-quality plant-based ingredients.' Flavours page marks vegan items with '(V)' (e.g. Dark Chocolate Sorbet, Mandarin Sorbet)
